description: Password-vault passkey secrets across surfaces: for an authenticator whose credential holds cred_random (CTAP2 CredRandomWithUV), the factor secret for a factor's prf_salt is HMAC-SHA-256(cred_random, SHA-256(UTF8("WebAuthn PRF") || 0x00 || prf_salt)) -- what a browser's prf eval.first = prf_salt returns and what pkg/vaultpasskey derives through hmac-secret. Read by pkg/vaultpasskey (xkey, xkmsctl) and sdk/ts (the browser) so a passkey enrolled on one surface unlocks on the other.
